paite: Huai lai in TOUPA'N ka kiang huanghang ate bang sek nawn inla, tang ah ka kiang ah hong pai inla, singkuang bawl in.
heading: Mosi In Thupiakte Ala Nawn / (Eks 34.1-10)
english: At that time Yahweh said to me, “Cut two stone tablets like the first, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make an ark of wood.

paite: Tuma lam a suangpek na hihkhapte a thu tuangte suangpekte ah ka gelh dia, singkuang ah na koih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.”

paite: Huchi in singgi sing in singkuang ka bawl a, tuma lam a bang suangpek nih ka sek a, suangpek nihte tawi in tang ah ka hohtou hi.
english: So I made an ark of acacia wood, and cut two stone tablets like the first, and went up onto the mountain, having the two tablets in my hand.

paite: Suangpekte ah ama a gelh bang, na kikhopkhawm ni ua tang a mei a pan TOUPA'N na kiang ua agen thupiak sawm agelh a, TOUPA'N ahon pia hi.
english: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahweh spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and Yahweh gave them to me.

paite: Tang a pan ka kiheisuk nawn a, ka singkuang bawl ah suangpek ka koih hi. TOUPA'N thu hon piak bang in huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and there they are as Yahweh commanded me.

paite: Israel suante Bene-jaakan tuileh a pan Moserah ah apai ua; huai ah Aaron asi a, huai ah avui uhi. Atapa Eleazar in amun ah siampu nna asem hi.
english: (The children of Israel traveled from Beeroth Bene Jaakan to Moserah. There Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his place.

paite: Huai a pan Gudgodah ah apai ua; Gudgodah a pan tuiluite gam Jotbathah ah apai uhi.
english: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of water.

paite: Huai lai in tutan a TOUPA thukhun singkuang zawng a, ama a TOUPA nna sem a, amin a vualzawlsakmi hi ding in Levi chi aseptuam hi.
english: At that time Yahweh set apart the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, to stand before Yahweh to minister to him, and to bless in his name, to this day.

paite: Huaiziak in Levi in a-unaute lak ah tantuan, goutan anei kei hi. TOUPA na Pathian un akiang a agen bang in TOUPA agoutan ahi.
english: Therefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brothers; Yahweh is his inheritance, according as Yahweh your God spoke to him.)

paite: Amalam mah bang in tang ah, ni sawmli ka om a; huai lai in leng TOUPA'N ka thu angaikhia a, TOUPA'N nou hon hihmangthang kei hi.
english: I stayed on the mountain, as at the first time, forty days and forty nights; and Yahweh listened to me that time also. Yahweh would not destroy you.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, mipite ma kai in; amaute piak dia api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam gam aluah ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, take your journey before the people; and they shall go in and possess the land which I swore to their fathers to give to them.”

paite: Khai le, Israel mite aw, nou a pan TOUPA na Pathian un ahon phut bangdang ahia, na hoihna ding ua TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siam a, alampi tengteng tawn a, amah it a, na lungtang tengteng uleh na lungsim tengteng ua TOUPA na Pathian uh nna sem a,
heading: Pathian In Aphut
english: Now, Israel, what does Yahweh your God require of you, but to fear Yahweh your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, and to serve Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

paite: TOUPA thupiakte, adante zuih dia tua thu ka hon piak zuih hilou maw?
english: to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?

paite: Ngai un, van leh van sangpente leh lei leh asung a om tengteng TOUPA na Pathian uh a vek ahi.
english: Behold, to Yahweh your God belongs heaven, the heaven of heavens, and the earth, with all that is therein.

paite: Himahleh na pi-le-pute it bel amah kipah lam ahi a, namdang tengteng tung ah noute, amau nung a asuante uh tua na hih mah bang un hon na telta hi.
english: Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.

paite: Huaiziak in na lungtang vun uh sum unla, genhak nawn kei un.
english: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh lah pathiante' Pathian, toupate' Toupa, Pathian thupitak, hattak, lauhuaitak, kuamah deihsak tuam nei lou a, golhna leng la ngei lou ahi ngal a.
english: For Yahweh your God, he is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, the mighty, and the awesome, who doesn’t respect persons or take bribes.

paite: Pa neiloute leh meithaite hoihtak in vai ahawmsak hi.
english: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.

paite: Huaiziak in gamdang mite it sam un; nou leng Aigupta gam ah gamdangmi na hi ngeita uhi.
english: Therefore love the foreigner, for you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan na siam ding ua, amah nna na sem ding ua; amah na len tinten ding ua, amin lou in na kichiam ding uh ahi.
english: You shall fear Yahweh your God. You shall serve him. You shall cling to him, and you shall swear by his name.

paite: Amah na phat dingpa uh ahi, hiai na mit ua na muh khitsa uh thil thupitak leh mulkimhuaitakte hon hihsakpa na Pathian uh ahi.
english: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

paite: Na pi-le-pute uh Aigupta gam ah mi sawmsagih apaisuk ua; tu in bel tamlam in van a aksi zah in TOUPA na Pathian un ahon tamsakta hi.
english: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now Yahweh your God has made you as the stars of the sky for multitude.
